description: Extracts the attributes stored on every uploaded file (any type: EXIF and container tags, document properties, archive contents, the facts of 3D files) into sys_* file attributes, typed ext_* file metadata and a GeoJSON location; with the deployment's GenAI analysis on, also describes and classifies the file with the configured Amazon Bedrock analysis model into genai_* file metadata, and, when vector search is enabled, publishes a per-file-version embedding for natural-language search. A system pipeline: read-only through the API except its enabled switch.
